title: The Koi Pond: A Strongly Lensed Protocluster Core hosting a Diverse Population of DSFGs
summary: We present James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) and Atacama Large Millimeter Array (ALMA) observations of PJ0846+15, \textit{The Koi Pond}, a strongly lensed protocluster core at Cosmic Noon. This field offers a magnified view of 11 dusty star-forming galaxies (DSFGs) all at $z=2.67$ (within $ΔV=800$ km s$^{-1}$) spanning a projected extent of $>300$ kpc lensed by a $z=0.77$ foreground cluster. NIRCam and ALMA Band 6 continuum measurements map the stellar distribution and thermal dust emission respectively at a spatial resolution of $\sim$0.15$^{\prime\prime}$. This analysis reveals a diverse population of DSFGs, with evidence of both interacting and non-interacting systems exhibiting a wide range of morphological features including spiral arms, bars, bulges, clumps/stellar clusters, tidal tails/debris and displaced molecular gas reservoirs. Comparing the rest-frame J- band continuum (F444W) vs (i-J) color (F277W$-$F444W), we find a wide range of values, suggesting a $>$1-dex spread in stellar mass and a dust attenuation reddening of $ΔA_{\mathrm{V}} > 1$ mag. The DSFG members exhibit varying dust sizes relative to the stellar emission, ranging from compact dusty cores to galaxy-wide emission. Resolved color maps of individual sources showing a spread as high as F277W$-$F444W$=2$ mag suggesting complex stellar-to-dust geometry. Although gas-rich mergers are identified in the core, the most red and dust emitting members are disks exhibiting clumpy structure indicating secular growth can drive these starburst events. Such a remarkable range in properties within this sample suggest DSFGs in protocluster core environments follow diverse evolutionary pathways towards their transition into quiescent, elliptical cluster galaxies.

title: A comprehensive SKA Survey of lensing clusters and lensed galaxies
comment: Published in Advancing Astrophysics with the SKAII (AASKAII), 2026(arXiv:2606.20366). Report-no:AASKAII/Pandey-Pommier02. Advancing Astrophysics with the SKAII(AASKAII) outlines the transformative scientific advances that will be enabled by the SKA telescopes
summary: Galaxy clusters act as powerful gravitational lenses that provide a unique laboratory for studying the distribution of dark matter and the properties of faint background galaxies. In the radio regime, cluster lensing studies remain largely unexplored due to the intrinsically low surface density of background radio sources, which limits the number of detectable lensed systems and constrains the application of cluster-scale lensing to cosmological and astrophysical investigations. In this paper, we outline how the SKA will transform cluster lensing studies through its unprecedented sensitivity, angular resolution, and survey speed. These capabilities will enable dense sampling of lensed background radio sources and high-fidelity reconstruction of cluster mass distributions, while revealing a previously inaccessible population of faint ($μ$Jy-level) galaxies, primarily at $z \sim 1-5$. We focus on three key science goals: (i) constraining dark matter substructure in galaxy clusters through improved strong-lensing constraints, (ii) characterising the non-thermal baryonic components of the intracluster medium, and (iii) building statistically significant samples of $μ$Jy-level lensed galaxies to study star formation and active galactic nuclei activity across cosmic time (primarily at $z \sim 1-5$). Together, these advances will establish cluster-scale radio lensing as a powerful probe of structure formation and galaxy evolution in the SKA era.

title: An Optical Illusion: High Electron Densities Create Extremely Metal-Poor Galaxy Impostors
summary: JWST has enabled the discovery of dozens of extremely metal-poor galaxies (EMPGs) with metallicities below $5\%\,Z_{\odot}$, representing a significant leap toward detecting the first galaxies without metals. However, accurate metallicity measurements require careful determination of physical conditions in the ionized gas. In this paper, we study four galaxies that appear to be EMPGs when analyzed using the direct $T_e$ method with the common low-density assumption ($n_e=10^3\,{\rm cm}^{-3}$). To test whether their metal-poor status holds when accurately measuring the density, we apply the direct method with a self-consistent determination of electron temperature ($T_e$) and density ($n_e$) in the high-ionization zone using the [OIII]$λ$5008, [OIII]$λ$4364, and [OIII]$λ$1666 lines, using JWST/NIRSpec data from the SPURS program in the Abell 2744 lensed field. We find that three out of four galaxies in our sample have extremely high electron densities ($n_e \sim 10^{5}-10^{6}\,{\rm cm^{-3}}$), which suppress the [OIII]$λ$5008 line and lead to underestimates of metallicity by up to $\sim1.1\,$dex when this density is not accounted for, and have true metallicities of 12+log(O/H) $\sim7.3-8.2$. Failure to account for high densities can therefore lead to systematic misclassification of metal-poor galaxies and biased conclusions about early chemical enrichment.

title: Tracing gas outflows in molecular gas-rich galaxies with the SKA
comment: Published in Advancing Astrophysics with the SKAII (AASKAII), 2026(arXiv:2606.20366). Report-no:AASKAII/Pandey-Pommier01. Advancing Astrophysics with the SKAII (AASKAII) outlines the transformative scientific advances that will be enabled by the SKA telescopes
summary: Active galactic nuclei with powerful radio jets play a key role in galaxy evolution through their ability to regulate the cold gas reservoirs that fuel star formation. Jet-driven feedback can heat, compress, or expel atomic and molecular gas, thereby reshaping the interstellar medium and altering star formation efficiency. However, the physical coupling between AGN activity and the multi-phase interstellar medium remains poorly constrained, particularly in radio-loud systems where mechanical feedback and multiphase outflows are expected to dominate. SKA will provide major advances in the study of cold gas in AGN host galaxies through sensitive observations of H~{\sc i} emission and absorption, together with access to selected low-frequency molecular transitions within the SKA~1 frequency range, including OH, H$_2$CO, CH$_3$OH, and, at high redshift, low-$J$ transitions of CO, HCN, and HCO$^{+}$ in rare bright systems. Combined with radio continuum measurements, these tracers will provide direct constraints on gas mass, kinematics, turbulence, and inflow/outflow signatures, enabling detailed studies of feedback-regulated cold gas reservoirs in AGN environments. In this chapter, we examine how SKA1 observations of neutral hydrogen, complemented by molecular-line and radio continuum studies, can be used to quantify multiphase gas flows and feedback energetics in molecular-gas-rich radio galaxies. SKA surveys will enable population-level studies of AGN-driven feedback, providing a new framework for understanding how radio jets regulate the cold interstellar medium and star formation across cosmic time.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 具有强大射电喷流的活跃星系核（AGN）通过调节为恒星形成提供燃料的冷气体储库，在星系演化中发挥着关键作用。喷流驱动的反馈可以加热、压缩或驱逐原子和分子气体，从而重塑星际介质并改变恒星形成效率。然而，AGN活动与多相星际介质之间的物理耦合仍然受到较差的约束，特别是在射电噪系统中，机械反馈和多相外流预计占主导地位。SKA将通过灵敏的H~{\sc i}发射和吸收观测，以及利用SKA~1频率范围内选定的低频分子跃迁（包括OH、H$_2$CO、CH$_3$OH，以及在高红移下罕见亮系统中的CO、HCN和HCO$^{+}$的低-$J$跃迁），为AGN宿主星系中冷气体的研究提供重大进展。结合射电连续谱测量，这些示踪物将直接约束气体质量、运动学、湍流以及内流/外流特征，从而能够详细研究AGN环境中反馈调节的冷气体储库。在本章中，我们考察了SKA1对中性氢的观测，辅以分子谱线和射电连续谱研究，如何用于量化富含分子气体的射电星系中的多相气体流动和反馈能量学。SKA巡天将实现AGN驱动反馈的群体级研究，为理解射电喷流如何调节冷星际介质和恒星形成提供新的框架。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于提供的摘要，SKA将显著推进AGN宿主星系中冷气体的研究，使射电喷流与冷气体反馈机制的量化研究从个别案例走向群体统计，为理解星系演化中的反馈调节开辟新途径。

title: The progenitors of $z\gtrsim10$ JWST galaxies in the COLIBRE simulations
summary: JWST has revealed a large population of luminous galaxies ($M_{\rm UV}\lesssim -20$) at redshifts $z \gtrsim 10$, widely interpreted as posing a challenge to models of galaxy formation within the $Λ$CDM cosmology. Here, we search for counterparts of the JWST galaxies in the COLIBRE simulations of galaxy formation. Although these simulations have not been tuned to reproduce any $z > 0$ observations, we find a population of COLIBRE galaxies with properties similar to those of the JWST galaxies, and trace them to their earliest evolutionary phases, $z\simeq25$, to investigate the onset of galaxy formation. We study the evolution of galaxy stellar masses, sizes, star formation rates, UV magnitudes, metallicities, central black hole masses, and molecular gas and dust content, finding good agreement with observationally inferred properties at $z > 10$, except for UV magnitudes and dust masses, which COLIBRE underpredicts and overpredicts, respectively. Our results indicate that the standard galaxy formation physics and $Λ$CDM cosmology adopted in COLIBRE are sufficient to reproduce a broad range of properties of the most extreme $z > 10$ JWST galaxies - including their compact sizes, stellar masses, gas content, and metallicities. We show that the discrepancies with the UV magnitudes and dust masses can both be attributed to the uncertain rate of grain growth at high redshift, possibly alongside a top-heavy stellar initial mass function. These findings provide strong evidence that the standard cosmological model can naturally explain even the most extreme galaxies in the early Universe.

artifacts.abstract_zh: JWST揭示了在红移\(z \gtrsim 10\)处存在大量明亮星系（\(M_{\rm UV}\lesssim -20\)），这被广泛解读为对ΛCDM宇宙学中星系形成模型的挑战。在此，我们在COLIBRE星系形成模拟中寻找JWST星系的对应体。尽管这些模拟并未针对任何\(z > 0\)的观测进行调优，但我们发现了一群性质与JWST星系相似的COLIBRE星系，并追踪它们到最早的演化阶段（\(z\simeq25\)），以研究星系形成的开端。我们研究了星系恒星质量、大小、恒星形成率、紫外星等、金属丰度、中心黑洞质量以及分子气体和尘埃含量的演化，发现除紫外星等和尘埃质量外（COLIBRE分别低估和高估了这两者），其余性质与\(z > 10\)处的观测推断性质吻合良好。我们的结果表明，COLIBRE所采用的标准星系形成物理和ΛCDM宇宙学足以复现最极端的\(z > 10\) JWST星系的广泛性质——包括其紧凑的尺寸、恒星质量、气体含量和金属丰度。我们表明，紫外星等和尘埃质量的差异均可归因于高红移处不确定的尘埃颗粒增长率，可能还伴随着顶部偏重的恒星初始质量函数。这些发现提供了强有力的证据，表明标准宇宙学模型能够自然地解释早期宇宙中最极端的星系。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要的结论：标准星系形成物理和ΛCDM宇宙学足以复现\(z>10\) JWST最极端星系的广泛性质（紧凑尺寸、恒星质量、气体含量、金属丰度），为宇宙学标准模型能够自然解释早期宇宙最极端星系提供了有力证据。

title: The efficient star-forming regions of stripped-envelope supernovae

summary: Massive stars ($> 8~\rm{M}_{\odot}$) play a key role in shaping the interstellar medium of galaxies through stellar feedback. However, how these stars form and evolve before exploding as core-collapse supernovae (SNe) remains elusive. We compute for the first time the star-formation efficiencies (SFEs) at the locations of hydrogen-rich (H-rich) SNe and stripped-envelope SNe (SESNe) to constrain their progenitor properties. We used VLT/MUSE and ALMA observations of H$α$/H$β$ and CO(2-1) emission lines to trace the components of the warm ionised gas and cold molecular gas, respectively. Both observations resolve individual H II regions and giant molecular clouds at spatial resolutions on cloud-scales ($\sim$100 pc). This combined data allows us to compute the SFE from the star formation rate (SFR) and the molecular gas mass (M$_{\rm{mol}}$) as SFE = SFR/M$_{\rm{mol}}$. We find that SESNe explode in environments that are currently forming stars eight times more efficiently than those of H-rich SNe (higher SFR for SESNe with similar M$_{\rm{mol}}$). On one hand, this is consistent with the scenario in which the majority of SESNe are produced from very massive stars ($> 20~\rm{M}_{\odot}$) if the initial mass function is top-heavy. On the other hand, most of SESN progenitor channels are formed from interacting binaries ($< 20~\rm{M}_{\odot}$) if an increased binary system formation rate is connected with turbulences and, in turn, with the boost to SFE. Then, an increased binary fraction could explain the enhanced H$α$ luminosities. In summary, SESNe preferentially occur in regions of intense, efficient star formation rather than simply higher gas content.

title: JWST Whirlpool Galaxy Treasury: Mid-Infrared Emission in M51 and its Relation to Gas Column and Star Formation
summary: Using JWST/MIRI imaging of M51 in eight broadband filters, we investigate correlations of mid-infrared emission from polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) and dust continuum with molecular, atomic, and ionized gas traced by CO(1-0), HI, and Pa-alpha, respectively. In molecular gas-dominated regions, PAH-dominated filters (F560W, F770W, F1130W, F1280W) exhibit near-linear correlations with CO(1-0) at 40 pc scale, indicating that PAHs are well-mixed with gas and experience relatively constant radiation field intensities. The F1500W, F1800W, and F2100W dust continuum-dominated filters show shallower slopes with CO(1-0), reflecting contributions from star-forming regions with high radiation field intensities. This is reinforced by the near-linear scaling between F2100W and Pa-alpha. PAH-dominated bands do not show this linear trend with Pa-alpha, likely due to their destruction in ionized regions. F1000W behaves similarly to PAH bands in its correlations with CO(1-0) and Pa-alpha. Modeling mid-infrared emission with an empirical decomposition into gas- and star-formation-associated components shows that PAH-dominated filters receive comparable contributions from both, while the relative contribution associated with the Pa-alpha template increases toward longer wavelengths, reaching $\sim$75% in F2100W. These results demonstrate that mid-infrared simultaneously traces the gas column and star formation, but with a systematic wavelength-dependent shift in what drives the correlations: PAHs being more gas-tracing and dust-continuum reflecting star formation. Lastly, considering both HI and H$_2$ at 440 pc resolution, we find a tight, linear relation between $Σ_{HI+H_2}$ and PAH-dominated filters. Although most of our coverage is in H$_2$-dominated regions, we note similar observations with HI, suggesting that PAHs are also well-mixed with atomic gas.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 利用JWST/MIRI对M51的八个宽带滤光片成像，我们研究了多环芳烃（PAHs）和尘埃连续谱的中红外发射与分别由CO(1-0)、HI和Pa-alpha示踪的分子、原子和电离气体的相关性。在分子气体主导的区域，PAH主导的滤光片（F560W、F770W、F1130W、F1280W）在40 pc尺度上与CO(1-0)表现出近线性相关，表明PAH与气体充分混合，并经历相对恒定的辐射场强度。F1500W、F1800W和F2100W尘埃连续谱主导的滤光片与CO(1-0)的斜率较浅，反映了来自高辐射场强度的恒星形成区的贡献。F2100W与Pa-alpha之间的近线性关系进一步支持了这一点。PAH主导的波段与Pa-alpha未显示这种线性趋势，可能由于PAH在电离区被破坏。F1000W在与CO(1-0)和Pa-alpha的相关性上表现出与PAH波段类似的行为。将中红外发射经验分解为与气体和恒星形成相关的成分进行建模表明，PAH主导的滤光片从两者获得相当的贡献，而与Pa-alpha模板相关的相对贡献随波长增加而增加，在F2100W中达到约75%。这些结果表明，中红外同时示踪气体柱密度和恒星形成，但驱动相关性的因素存在系统的波长依赖性转变：PAH更多示踪气体，而尘埃连续谱反映恒星形成。最后，在440 pc分辨率下同时考虑HI和H$_2$，我们发现$Σ_{HI+H_2}$与PAH主导的滤光片之间存在紧密的线性关系。尽管我们的大部分覆盖区域是H$_2$主导的，但我们注意到与HI的类似观测，表明PAH也与原子气体充分混合。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要的AI结论：中红外发射同时示踪气体柱密度和恒星形成，但存在系统性的波长依赖性转变：PAH更多示踪气体，尘埃连续谱反映恒星形成。PAH在电离区被破坏，而在分子气体和原子气体中均与气体充分混合。

title: OH Line Detections in Southern Galaxies of the IRAS Revised Bright Galaxy Sample
summary: We present a systematic study of OH main-line emission and absorption in 186 southern galaxies from the IRAS Revised Bright Galaxy Sample, using archival MeerKAT snapshot data. OH features are detected in 38 galaxies, including eight with OH maser emission (three new) and 30 showing OH absorption, mostly unreported previously. Four absorption systems exhibit weak OH emission superposed on strong absorption. OH-emitting regions are generally more compact than the associated radio continuum. Most absorption profiles are well fit by two Gaussian components (1667 and 1665 MHz), with an average integrated line ratio of $\sim$1.5. LIRGs show an OH emission detection rate of ~13\%, versus significantly lower rates in non-LIRGs. For sources with radio continuum flux densities >20 mJy, OH absorption detection rates reach ~36\% (LIRGs) and ~27\% (non-LIRGs), while no OH absorption features were detected among sources with lower radio continuum flux densities. This suggests that sufficient background continuum is likely an important factor for the detection of OH absorption. Detected OH emitters follow the empirical $L_{\rm OH}$--$L_{\rm FIR}$ relation, consistent with far-infrared pumping, while non-detections show upper limits below the relation. No significant differences are found between OH absorbers and non-detections in infrared luminosity or radio continuum compactness. Stacked spectra of non-detections reveal no significant OH features, suggesting that sensitivity and orientation alone do not fully explain the absence of absorption. In contrast, mid-infrared colors (e.g., W2--W3) and q_TIR differ between the two populations. OH absorption galaxies occupy an intermediate regime in L_HCN/L_CO between OH megamasers and non-detections, implying that OH absorption detectability is linked to dense molecular gas conditions, with extreme star formation potentially suppressing its occurrence.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们利用档案MeerKAT快照数据，对IRAS修订亮星系样本中的186个南天星系进行了OH主线发射和吸收的系统研究。在38个星系中探测到OH特征，其中8个具有OH脉泽发射（3个为新发现），30个显示OH吸收，且大多数此前未被报道。四个吸收系统在强吸收上叠加了微弱的OH发射。OH发射区域通常比相关的射电连续谱更紧凑。大多数吸收谱线可以用两个高斯分量（1667和1665 MHz）很好地拟合，平均积分线比约为$\sim$1.5。LIRG的OH发射探测率约为13%，远高于非LIRG。对于射电连续谱流量密度大于20 mJy的源，OH吸收探测率分别达到约36%（LIRG）和约27%（非LIRG），而在射电连续谱流量密度较低的源中未探测到OH吸收特征。这表明足够的背景连续谱可能是探测OH吸收的重要因素。探测到的OH发射源遵循经验性的$L_{\rm OH}$--$L_{\rm FIR}$关系，与远红外抽运一致，而未探测到的源显示出低于该关系的上限。在红外光度或射电连续谱致密性方面，OH吸收源与非探测源之间没有显著差异。非探测源的叠加光谱未显示显著的OH特征，表明仅灵敏度和取向并不能完全解释吸收缺失的原因。相比之下，中红外颜色（如W2--W3）和q_TIR在两个群体之间存在差异。OH吸收星系在L_HCN/L_CO中占据OH巨脉泽和非探测源之间的中间区域，表明OH吸收的可探测性与致密分子气体条件相关，而极端恒星形成可能抑制其出现。

title: SPT-3G+: A Cosmic Microwave Background Experiment for the South Pole Telescope
comment: 22 pages, 7 figures, Proceedings for SPIE Astronomincal Telescopes + Instrumentation 2026 Paper 14156-14
summary: SPT-3G+ is the next survey receiver planned to be installed in early 2029 on the 10-meter South Pole Telescope (SPT). This new receiver will feature 6,020 polarization-sensitive dichroic pixels with transition-edge sensors observing in frequency bands centered at 90 GHz and 150 GHz. The 24,080 detectors in the SPT-3G+ receiver will be cooled to 100 mK by a dilution refrigerator and read out using microwave SQUID multiplexing. The optical design of the receiver enables a 4 degree diameter field of view, which is broken up into 14 individual optics tubes each containing cryogenic alumina, silicon, and nylon lenses. These technology choices will allow the SPT-3G+ receiver to improve on the mapping speed of the currently operating SPT-3G receiver by nearly an order of magnitude. Once deployed, the SPT-3G+ receiver will observe for 6-years an area overlapping with the BICEP survey to achieve a combined (90 GHz and 150 GHz) CMB map depth of 0.5 uK-arcmin. Data from these observations will be used to create unprecedentedly deep CMB lensing maps, discover new galaxy clusters, and detect astrophysical transients. The lensing map produced by SPT-3G+ will be used to remove or "delens" foreground B modes, where large-scale structure gravitationally lenses the CMB and converts E modes into B-mode polarization, with the goal of revealing inflationary B modes. Together with data from the BICEP Array as part of the South Pole Observatory, SPT-3G+ data will be used to constrain the tensor-to-scalar ratio $r$ with a goal of achieving a measurement of $σ(r) = 0.001$

title: Diversity of Ionized Gas Structures in Nearby Metal-poor Dwarf Galaxies
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to PASJ. Comments are very welcome!
summary: We investigate whether optical and far-infrared [O III] emission from nearby metal-poor dwarf galaxies can be represented by a homogeneous one-zone ionized-gas model with a single electron temperature and density. Our sample comprises five galaxies from the Herschel Dwarf Galaxy Survey: HS1222+3741, SBS0335-052E, POX186, Haro11, and IZw18. We combine galaxy-integrated or nearly galaxy-integrated [O III] 4363 and 5007 measurements from Seimei/KOOLS-IFU observations and published or archival spectroscopy with Herschel/PACS [O III] 88um measurements. Because [O III] 4363 is not detected in HS1222+3741, the analysis is based on the remaining four galaxies. SBS0335-052E and Haro11 lie near or slightly beyond the low-density boundary of the one-zone diagnostic. Their nominal line ratios favor effective densities of ne<1cm-3, while conservative treatment of the uncertainties allows values up to 40 and 10cm-3, respectively. These remain substantially below densities inferred from independent diagnostics. By contrast, POX186 and IZw18 show no significant discrepancy between the optical--far-infrared [O III] and low-ionization optical diagnostics. Additional optical and ultraviolet diagnostics show that inferred densities can span several orders of magnitude within a galaxy. Representative two-zone models reproduce the [O III] 4363, 5007, and 88um emission in SBS0335-052E and Haro11 by combining relatively dense gas with cooler, low-density gas. The low-density component contributes approximately 61% and 72% of the 88um luminosity, but only 14% and 23% of the 5007 luminosity, respectively. These solutions are not unique and may represent a broader unresolved distribution of gas conditions. Our results show that temperatures and densities inferred from integrated one-zone analyses are effective quantities and that similar diagnostic discrepancies can arise in nearby metal-poor galaxies.

figures.caption_zh: 图2：HS 1222+3741和SBS 0335–052E的Seimei/KOOLS-IFU光谱。左上：使用VPH495光栅观测的HS 1222+3741。右上：使用VPH683光栅观测的HS 1222+3741。底部：使用VPH-blue光栅观测的SBS 0335–052E。水平轴显示观测框架波长。垂直蓝色虚线表示发射线的预期波长。左上面板中的放大插图显示了H \(\gamma\) 和[O iii ] \(\lambda 4363\) 周围的光谱区域；在HS 1222+3741中这两条线均未探测到。底部面板中的放大插图分别显示了H \(\gamma\) 和[O iii ] \(\lambda 4363\) 周围，以及[S ii ] \(\lambda\lambda 6716,6731\) 双线周围的光谱区域；这些发射线在SBS 0335–052E中被探测到。红色曲线显示了对发射线的高斯拟合。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3: [O iii ] diagnostic diagram based on the [O iii ] 88 \(\micron\) /[O iii ] \(\lambda 5007\) and [O iii ] \(\lambda 4363\) /[O iii ] \(\lambda 5007\) ratios. The horizontal and vertical axes show \(\log_{10}(\mbox{[O\,{\sc iii}]}\ 88~\micron/\mbox{[O\,{\sc iii}]}\ \lambda 5007)\) and \(\log_{10}(\mbox{[O\,{\sc iii}]}\ \lambda 4363/\mbox{[O\,{\sc iii}]}\ \lambda 5007)\) , respectively. Solid and dashed curves show one-zone model predictions calculated with PyNeb version 1.1.32 for different electron temperatures, \(T_{e}\) , and electron densities, \(n_{e}\) , respectively. Filled symbols indicate nearby galaxies, including the five galaxies in our primary sample, Mrk 71 ( 8 ) , and Haro 3 Region A ( 9 ) . Open symbols indicate high-redshift galaxies from the literature ( 70 ; 25 ; 20 ; 82 ; 24 ; 75 ) . The downward arrow for HS 1222+3741 indicates the 3 \(\sigma\) upper limit on [O iii ] \(\lambda 4363\) ; this galaxy is not used to assess consistency with the one-zone model. The horizontal error bars include an additional 10% systematic uncertainty to account for possible relative flux-calibration differences between the optical and Herschel /PACS measurements. For display purposes, the plotted position of I Zw 18 is shifted by \(-0.03\) dex along the horizontal axis and by \(-0.02\) dex along the vertical axis relative to its measured values.
figures.caption_zh: 图3：基于[O iii ] 88 \(\micron\) /[O iii ] \(\lambda 5007\) 和[O iii ] \(\lambda 4363\) /[O iii ] \(\lambda 5007\) 比值的[O iii ]诊断图。水平轴和垂直轴分别显示 \(\log_{10}(\mbox{[O\,{\sc iii}]}\ 88~\micron/\mbox{[O\,{\sc iii}]}\ \lambda 5007)\) 和 \(\log_{10}(\mbox{[O\,{\sc iii}]}\ \lambda 4363/\mbox{[O\,{\sc iii}]}\ \lambda 5007)\) 。实线和虚线分别显示了使用PyNeb版本1.1.32计算的不同电子温度 \(T_{e}\) 和电子密度 \(n_{e}\) 下的单区模型预测。填充符号表示近邻星系，包括我们主要样本中的五个星系、Mrk 71 ( 8 ) 和Haro 3 Region A ( 9 ) 。开放符号表示文献中的高红移星系 ( 70 ; 25 ; 20 ; 82 ; 24 ; 75 ) 。HS 1222+3741的向下箭头表示[O iii ] \(\lambda 4363\) 的3 \(\sigma\) 上限；该星系不用于评估与单区模型的一致性。水平误差线包括额外的10%系统不确定性，以考虑光学和Herschel /PACS测量之间可能的相对通量校准差异。为了显示目的，I Zw 18的绘制位置相对于其测量值沿水平轴移动了 \(-0.03\) dex，沿垂直轴移动了 \(-0.02\) dex。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: Comparison of electron densities inferred from different optical and ultraviolet diagnostics with the effective electron densities required to reproduce the observed [O iii ] 88 \(\micron\) /[O iii ] \(\lambda 5007\) ratios under the one-zone assumption. Top left: SBS 0335–052E. Top right: POX 186. Bottom left: Haro 11. Bottom right: I Zw 18. For Haro 11, constraints from both the [O ii ] and [S ii ] doublets are shown. The blue curves show the theoretical [O iii ] 88 \(\micron/\lambda 5007\) ratios as functions of \(n_{e}\) at the adopted \(T_{e}({O^{++}})\) , with the blue shaded regions indicating the uncertainties due to \(T_{e}\) . For SBS 0335–052E, the green curve additionally shows the prediction adopting \(T_{e}({S^{++}})\) derived from [S iii ] \(\lambda 6312/\lambda 9069\) . The red horizontal lines and shaded regions show the observed ratios and their \(1\sigma\) uncertainties, including the adopted 10% systematic uncertainty in the optical–far-infrared ratio. The vertical black lines and gray shaded regions indicate the densities and their \(1\sigma\) uncertainties inferred from the low-ionization optical doublets; solid and dashed lines denote the [S ii ]- and [O ii ]-based estimates, respectively. Additional literature-based optical and ultraviolet density diagnostics are shown as vertical reference lines and are adopted from 51 for SBS 0335–052E, Haro 11, and I Zw 18, and from 62 for POX 186. For POX 186, the leftward arrow indicates that the [C iii ] \(\lambda 1907\) /C iii ] \(\lambda 1909\) ratio is consistent with the low-density limit, corresponding to \(n_{e}=1^{+2300}_{-1}~{cm}^{-3}\) ; the vertical cap marks the \(1\sigma\) upper bound.
figures.caption_zh: 图4：从不同光学和紫外诊断推断的电子密度与在单区假设下重现观测到的[O iii ] 88 \(\micron\) /[O iii ] \(\lambda 5007\) 比值所需的有效电子密度的比较。左上：SBS 0335–052E。右上：POX 186。左下：Haro 11。右下：I Zw 18。对于Haro 11，显示了[O ii ]和[S ii ]双线的约束。蓝色曲线显示了在采用的 \(T_{e}({O^{++}})\) 下，理论[O iii ] 88 \(\micron/\lambda 5007\) 比值作为 \(n_{e}\) 的函数，蓝色阴影区域表示由于 \(T_{e}\) 引起的不确定性。对于SBS 0335–052E，绿色曲线额外显示了采用从[S iii ] \(\lambda 6312/\lambda 9069\) 导出的 \(T_{e}({S^{++}})\) 的预测。红色水平线和阴影区域显示了观测比值及其 \(1\sigma\) 不确定性，包括采用的光学-远红外比值的10%系统不确定性。垂直黑线和灰色阴影区域表示从低电离光学双线推断的密度及其 \(1\sigma\) 不确定性；实线和虚线分别表示基于[S ii ]和[O ii ]的估计。额外的基于文献的光学和紫外密度诊断显示为垂直参考线，分别取自51（针对SBS 0335–052E、Haro 11和I Zw 18）和62（针对POX 186）。对于POX 186，向左的箭头表示[C iii ] \(\lambda 1907\) /C iii ] \(\lambda 1909\) 比值与低密度极限一致，对应于 \(n_{e}=1^{+2300}_{-1}~{cm}^{-3}\) ；垂直帽标记 \(1\sigma\) 上限。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5: Two-zone models for SBS 0335–052E (top) and Haro 11 (bottom). In each row, the left panel shows the observed [O iii ] \(\lambda 4363\) /[O iii ] \(\lambda 5007\) and [O iii ] 88 \(\micron\) /[O iii ] \(\lambda 5007\) ratios together with the mixing sequence connecting the adopted Zone 1 and Zone 2 conditions. The right panels show the predicted [O iii ] 88 \(\micron\) /[O iii ] \(\lambda 5007\) and [O iii ] \(\lambda 4363\) /[O iii ] \(\lambda 5007\) ratios, respectively, as functions of the effective emitting-volume ratio \(V_{1}/V_{2}\) . The horizontal solid lines and shaded regions indicate the observed ratios and their \(1\sigma\) uncertainties, respectively, while the vertical dashed lines mark the best-fitting effective emitting-volume ratios. For the [O iii ] 88 \(\micron\) /[O iii ] \(\lambda 5007\) ratio, the observational uncertainty includes the same additional 10% systematic uncertainty adopted in figures 3 and 4 to account for possible relative flux-calibration differences between the optical and far-infrared measurements. The adopted two-zone solutions reproduce both observed [O iii ] line ratios simultaneously. The inferred temperatures, densities, and effective emitting-volume ratios should be regarded as representative rather than unique because the available three [O iii ] lines do not fully constrain all two-zone model parameters.
figures.caption_zh: 图5：SBS 0335–052E（上）和Haro 11（下）的两区模型。在每一行中，左面板显示了观测到的[O iii ] \(\lambda 4363\) /[O iii ] \(\lambda 5007\) 和[O iii ] 88 \(\micron\) /[O iii ] \(\lambda 5007\) 比值，以及连接所采用的Zone 1和Zone 2条件的混合序列。右面板分别显示了预测的[O iii ] 88 \(\micron\) /[O iii ] \(\lambda 5007\) 和[O iii ] \(\lambda 4363\) /[O iii ] \(\lambda 5007\) 比值作为有效发射体积比 \(V_{1}/V_{2}\) 的函数。水平实线和阴影区域分别表示观测比值及其 \(1\sigma\) 不确定性，而垂直虚线标记了最佳拟合的有效发射体积比。对于[O iii ] 88 \(\micron\) /[O iii ] \(\lambda 5007\) 比值，观测不确定性包括图3和图4中采用的额外10%系统不确定性，以考虑光学和远红外测量之间可能的相对通量校准差异。所采用的两区解同时再现了观测到的两个[O iii ]线比。推断的温度、密度和有效发射体积比应被视为代表性而非唯一，因为可用的三条[O iii ]线并未完全约束所有两区模型参数。
